categories.main_business_segments: China Jushi Co., Ltd primarily engages in the production and sales of glass fiber and its products, including glass fiber yarn and related materials. The company also operates in building materials sales, new material technology development and services, as well as power generation, transmission, and distribution businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced glass fiber production technologies including high-performance glass formulations, impregnation agent formulations, large-scale tank kiln design, and proprietary platinum-rhodium alloy sieve plate technology. It emphasizes zero-carbon intelligent manufacturing, digital factory construction, and green manufacturing processes, supported by extensive R&D in glass fiber and composite materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: China Jushi serves a broad range of industries including infrastructure, construction materials, transportation, electronics, energy and environmental protection, consumer goods, and emerging sectors such as automotive lightweighting, 5G, wind power, and photovoltaics. Its products are used globally in composite materials, electrical insulation, and thermal insulation applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates six major production bases across China (Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Jiangsu) and overseas in Egypt, the United States, and India. It has a comprehensive global marketing network with sales subsidiaries in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Africa, covering over 100 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Jushi operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing glass fiber and related products. It also extends upstream into raw material processing and downstream into composite materials and power generation, aiming to build an integrated glass fiber industry ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality development, efficiency improvement, and product quality enhancement. Strategic priorities include expanding glass fiber business core, strengthening supply and industrial chains, promoting digital and intelligent manufacturing, and advancing green low-carbon initiatives. R&D emphasizes glass formula innovation, impregnation agents, product development, clean production, and intelligent manufacturing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of glass fiber yarns and related products. The company also earns income from power generation projects and provides technical services. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Jushi is a global leader and the largest producer in the glass fiber industry, holding the top position in hot-set roving, thermoplastic reinforcement, and electronic base cloth production. It competes with major global players such as Taishan Fiberglass, Chongqing International Composite Materials, Owens Corning (USA), and Nippon Electric Glass (Japan). The industry is oligopolistic with high entry barriers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, China Jushi reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 15.86 billion, a 6.59% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.44 billion, a 19.7% decrease. The company maintains total assets of RMB 53.38 billion and net assets of RMB 30.04 billion, showing steady growth and strong cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Jushi emphasizes its scale advantage as the world's largest glass fiber producer, technological leadership with proprietary core technologies, global production and marketing footprint, and strong brand reputation. It offers a broad product portfolio including high-modulus and high-performance glass fibers, focusing on quality, cost efficiency, and green low-carbon manufacturing to meet diverse and evolving customer needs.
